requirements.invariant: Explicit local project and application source; five runtime services; finite metadata.
requirements.implementation: docker_sample; source guard and service filtering

requirements.problem: Distinguish OOM from a generic process exit.
requirements.invariant: OOM reason and prior incident survive container recovery.

requirements.problem: Missing observation must not look healthy.
requirements.invariant: 90-second staleness, clock mismatch, transport failure or bounded event gap yields UNKNOWN.

requirements.problem: Responsibility is different from verified recovery.
requirements.invariant: Acknowledgement/actions never refresh samples; close requires responsibility, action and two fresh good host samples.

requirements.problem: Backup failure must remain visible without rewriting the recovery point.
requirements.invariant: Only actual backup outcome hook; separate host incident and R2.3 receipts.

requirements.problem: Preserve useful private history without unlimited growth.
requirements.invariant: Existing owner-only store, bounded events/incidents, retained closed history and explicit prune counts.
